method: visual inspection of 13 per-cue thumbnail sheets rendered from the raw Bayer G1 plane under the Phase G crop (3.2x viewing gain); block-level verdict per row
ceiling: CUE-AWARE compliance annotation, NOT blind: the annotator saw each row's cue label, so this confirms the cued pose is present, it is not an independent blind pose label. hold_confirmed rows are usable to claim "captured under cue X with the cued pose visually present". settling rows (onset to hold) and no_cue_truth (pre_cue) are excluded. Block-level, not per-row-precise; hold_from is BOSUN's first-confirmed-hold row per cue. A blind independent annotation (cue labels hidden/shuffled) remains a separate pass if a stronger claim is needed. The 288 verification rows were not opened.
